notes: Required 8 extraction runs. Root cause of every defect was identical: when the test plan lacked an exact-match step pattern for an AC's specific fact, the extractor silently substituted a neighbouring requirement's steps. Fixed by growing the step-definition library from 85 to 210 patterns. 23 semantic defects were found and closed, including one inverted-logic scenario (REQ-025 AC-2 asserted inequality where the AC requires equality). Verified independently by scripted checks, not only by the server.
